name: Mizunagi Moeno
source:
Student and daughter of Kumiko. Doesn't remember protagonist when they were younger. Is kind daughter trying to help her mother with job. But because she is clumsy and nervous isn't very good at her job. 
          The protagonist decides to help her get over nervousness by having her do embarrassing things so nothing will bother her at work.
